name: t3_linux_audit_evasion
label: true_positive
description: An operator on a Linux host disabling the audit subsystem, clearing shell history, and making a dropped file immutable, all with standard system tools.
detectable_as: The audit rules being flushed, which auditd itself records before it stops recording. After that the host is dark.
why_hard: The detection window closes with the first command. Everything after it is unlogged, so a product that only correlates across several events never gets the chance.
